::: {.callout-warning}
**Independent preview.** MLPerf EDU is not an official MLCommons benchmark and is not endorsed by MLCommons. Registry result labels are candidate classifications for review, not accepted MLPerf result categories.
:::

The catalog is generated from the workload registry, [`datasets.yaml`](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/blob/main/mlperf-edu/datasets.yaml), and the structured public-asset dossiers used by the harness. Every registry dataset is listed, and unresolved release decisions are marked explicitly.

::: {.callout-note}
**Release boundary.** Dataset status covers the named asset only. The MLPerf EDU component license, package-index publication, dataset rights, and MLCommons review remain separate release gates. Fetch-only status does not authorize redistribution.
:::

Fetch and inspect assets from a source checkout:

```bash
uv run mlperf fetch --profile max --dry-run   # show what would be downloaded
uv run mlperf info --dataset tinyshakespeare  # one dataset's dossier
uv run mlperf cache list                      # inspect the local cache
```
